params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly changes all public class variable fields to private, addressing the SonarQube warning about public class variable fields violating encapsulation. It then adds appropriate getter and setter methods for each private field, enabling controlled access and modification. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes; the patch strictly focuses on fixing the warning with minimal impact on other parts of the code.
